newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WADDLE SET TO JOIN FOREST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WADDLE SET TO JOIN FOREST.

text.p: Former England winger Chris Waddle said on Thursday he expected to join English premier league Nottingham Forest on a free transfer.

"I expect everything to be settled late today," said the 36-year-old winger, who made his name with Newcastle, Tottenham and former European champions Marseille. He currently plays for first division Bradford City.
Forest confirmed they were interested in Waddle but had not agreed a deal.
"Everybody knows about Chris's ability and he would be a wonderful asset to Forest. We certainly hope to tie up the deal by Friday," general manager Dave Bassett said.
If Waddle reaches agreement with the struggling premier league side he would become the third forward to join them this week.
On Monday, they signed Dutch striker Pierre Van Hooydonk from Glasgow Celtic for an initial fee of 3.0 million pounds ($4.8 million).
Forest were holding a news conference later on Thursday to announce the signing of England under-21 striker Ian Moore from first division Tranmere.
The Midlands club was the subject of a successful takeover bid last month which freed up around 16 million pounds ($25.6 million) for new players.
They are 18th in the 20-team premier league and have scored just two goals in their last eight matches. They play second-placed Liverpool on Saturday.
